instructions: The independent reviewer creates a unique request file and executes the command themselves.

Freeze the author's exact declared source closure; include implementation, test, imported contract/tool and delivered documentation inputs. Source paths are relative to contoso-corr-poc; ..\.github paths are allowed only as source inputs inside the repository.
testFiles must be focused Node test files included in sourcePaths. positiveTests and negativeTests contain distinct exact successful TAP test names, not invented labels.

The helper binds current fresh roster and exact existing child definitions, measures source hashes before/after, executes Node TAP, and saves immutable tests.tap, stderr.txt and contoso.code-review.v1 review.json.
Send the returned receipt and the exact child acceptance findings/limitations to the orchestrator. Local source reviews do not close native or hosted-PR children.
Do not include tools\kanban.mjs or tests\kanban.test.mjs unless reviewing the orchestrator's own packet; these are still changing and unrelated inclusion will make a receipt stale.
No full npm suite or Maven command is executed by this helper. The parent owns final integrated validation.

positiveTests: REPLACE WITH EXACT PASSING POSITIVE TEST NAME
negativeTests: REPLACE WITH EXACT PASSING NEGATIVE ASSERTION NAME
